purpose: Measure whether the V72 sampling-sensitive scientific gate is statistically attainable at sixteen truth queries per domain before spending another fresh partition or training another generator. Use only already-consumed V70 fit-train truth, cluster-aware truth-versus-truth oracle bootstraps, a TNG spatial heterogeneity jackknife, and a paired stability audit of the already consumed V72 stage-A maximum-energy comparison.

TNG100.grouping: four x-z quadrants from center_position_mpc_h using x<37.5 and z<37.5; four truth queries from each quadrant per trial

SIMBA.grouping: CAMELS realizations 16-23; two truth queries from each realization per trial

Swift.grouping: CAMELS realizations 0-19; select sixteen realizations without replacement and one truth query from each selected realization per trial

metadata_precheck_already_performed_with.verified_shapes: truth and deterministic fields are aligned [objects,1,64,64,64]

per_truth_or_deterministic_cube: largest 2048 log10-density voxel values in descending order
Hann-windowed log-density power spectrum using the frozen SpectralBinner
open-boundary two-point function through 10 Mpc/h using the frozen OpenBoundaryTwoPoint
summary_cache.top_2048_exactness: At q=0.99999, sixteen cubes require at most the largest 43 pooled values and 256 resampled cubes require at most the largest 673 pooled values; 2048 values per distinct cube is sufficient for exact linear-interpolated pooled quantiles even in the worst concentration case.

same_domain_truth_oracle_bootstrap.query_selection: without replacement under the frozen domain group quotas
same_domain_truth_oracle_bootstrap.oracle_selection: for each query, draw sixteen indices with replacement from the same group after excluding every query index in that trial; duplicates are retained as an ordinary empirical cluster bootstrap and unique-donor counts are reported
same_domain_truth_oracle_bootstrap.second_exchangeable_oracle: draw an independent oracle ensemble B by the identical rule solely to measure the finite-sample behavior of a strict A-better-than-B maximum-energy comparison

measurements.q99_999: absolute pooled oracle-minus-query log10rho q99.999 difference <=0.1 dex
measurements.Q4: pooled oracle-over-query mean delta-squared ratio in [2/3,1.5]
measurements.high_k_power: mean oracle-over-query total log-density power in [0.9,1.1] in both 3-6 and 6-10.0531 h/Mpc bands
measurements.residual_RMS: oracle cubes' own centered truth-minus-own-deterministic residual RMS over query cubes' corresponding residual RMS in [0.9,1.1]
measurements.density_PDF: oracle-versus-query histogram TV is strictly lower than deterministic-query-versus-query histogram TV
measurements.two_point: the frozen KS between sixteen query rows and 256 oracle rows is strictly lower than the frozen KS between the same query rows and their sixteen deterministic rows in every 0-1, 1-3, and 3-10 Mpc/h scale mean
measurements.environment: every frozen oracle mean peak/void statistic has strictly smaller absolute error from the query truth mean than the deterministic query mean
measurements.maximum_energy: mean per-query unbiased scalar energy score from oracle A maxima is strictly lower than exchangeable oracle B; this relative coin-flip diagnostic is excluded from the absolute attainability decision

same_domain_truth_oracle_bootstrap.sampling_sensitive_core_joint: all absolute and comparative morphology core checks pass

explicit_exclusions.rank_histogram_and_voxel_coverage: truth fields from different queries are not exchangeable at aligned voxels conditional on only a coarse group; using them would not be a valid perfect conditional-model null
explicit_exclusions.exact_DC: a deterministic numerical invariant with no sampling uncertainty
explicit_exclusions.maximum_energy_from_joint_decision: requires a named model-versus-control alternative, not an absolute perfect-model null

cross_domain_common_law_stress.ordered_pairs: all six source-domain to different target-domain pairs
cross_domain_common_law_stress.source_oracle: 256 truth cubes drawn with replacement with equal probability per source x-z quadrant or source CAMELS realization, then uniformly within that group
cross_domain_common_law_stress.interpretation_limit: This tests a domain-blind common empirical law. Failure is not a mathematical lower bound for a conditional model because target-free inputs could identify domain differences; it becomes relevant only together with an identifiability audit such as V67.

TNG_spatial_heterogeneity_jackknife.operation: compute full-fit and four leave-one-quadrant-out q99.999, Q4, two high-k powers, two-point means, and maximum-distribution summaries
material_if_any: leave-one-block-out mean power maximum/minimum exceeds 1.1 in either frozen high-k band
TNG_spatial_heterogeneity_jackknife.claim_limit: This is a within-box spatial heterogeneity diagnostic, not an estimate of independent-box cosmic variance.

consumed_V72_energy_stability.resampling_unit: the sixteen already consumed stage-A queries within each domain
consumed_V72_energy_stability.report: paired mean candidate-minus-control energy, percentile 95% bootstrap interval, and bootstrap probability that the mean is below zero
consumed_V72_energy_stability.decision_role: diagnostic only; never changes or reopens V72

predeclared_decisions.gate_redesign_required: same-domain truth-oracle all-three-domain sampling-sensitive core joint pass probability is below 0.8, or any single domain's absolute-core pass probability is below 0.8
predeclared_decisions.domain_blind_common_law_materially_incom: any ordered cross-domain pair has absolute-core joint pass probability below 0.2; this is a stress finding, not proof that a conditional model is impossible
predeclared_decisions.V72_energy_difference_underpowered: the paired 95% bootstrap interval contains zero; report independently per domain without changing the sealed Boolean outcome
predeclared_decisions.TNG_spatial_heterogeneity_material: any frozen leave-one-block criterion is met
predeclared_decisions.if_gate_redesign_required: stop all new Hong generator candidates and propose a separately approved null-calibrated gate redesign before any fresh payload
predeclared_decisions.if_gate_reliable_but_domain_stress_or_TN: run a target-free identifiability and independent-box design audit before any new generator
predeclared_decisions.if_gate_reliable_and_no_material_stress: a separately frozen candidate design may be considered, but this audit does not authorize it or any fresh payload

resource_and_firewall.validation_or_development_access: forbidden except the six explicitly hash-bound already consumed V72 stage-A ensemble files for the energy stability diagnostic
resource_and_firewall.new_candidate_or_gate_change_after_resul: requires a separate program and explicit user approval
